config.cstar_role: exact-score choice and fully factorized reference geometry by target construction; not an ESS optimum found by search
config.init_strategy: Pathfinder from an arm-transported common model-frame point

materiality_rule.materially_better: median proxy/optimum > 1.25 and at least 75% of seeds > 1.25
materiality_rule.materially_worse: median proxy/optimum < 0.8 and at least 75% of seeds < 0.8
materiality_rule.metric: paired per-chain minimum bulk ESS per 1000 gradients

config.representativeness: synthetic K=3 stress/control with BRM-like draw-varying scales and dense correlation; not a fitted BRM posterior
